sloka: ततः श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः ।आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः सो ऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः ।। ५.६४.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ śrutvā ninādaṁ taṁ kapīnāṁ kapisattamaḥ ।āyatāñcitalāṅgūlaḥ so 'bhavaddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 5.64.34 ।।।।

translations.english: The great Sugriva heard the roar of the monkeys and was extremely happy. He kept raising and shaking his long tail in joy.
